verdict.rationale: Render documents built-in infrastructure metrics from day zero, with streaming to external tools, and CPU/memory metrics that agents can inspect. This covers part of the 'site performance' half of the story at the infrastructure level. Nothing in the evidence shows visitor-behavior or web analytics such as page views, sessions or traffic sources. Missing for 10: visitor behavior analytics, page/request-level site performance analytics (e.g. web vitals, response times per route), detailed docs on the metrics offering, independent corroboration.
